rows.label: qst500206_msg0101
rows.name:
I liked the cave in Acedia so much
that I stayed there for ages, mo.

rows.label: qst500206_msg0102
rows.name:
Then the ground started shaking hard,
and before I knew it the World Tree
was right in front of me, mo!

rows.label: qst500206_msg0103
rows.name:
That was the biggest shock of my life,
mo!

rows.label: qst500206_msg0104
rows.name:
Then I followed everyone, got onto a
ship, and escaped Acedia safely, mo.

rows.label: qst500206_msg0106
rows.name:
The Fortis Trade Guild travel guide
says to keep traveling even when
things get hard, mo...

rows.label: qst500206_msg0107
rows.name:
Everyone helped me a lot, but Foorara
still wants to continue the journey,
mo!

rows.label: qst500206_msg0108
rows.name:
I'm tired of hot places, so next I'll
head for Luxuria, mo!
